thread:
ryan: Borealis asked if we can onboard a customer-trained Mistral-7B variant (rebased) + an external retriever plugin for a 2-week POC. They want hosted for speed but are open to Dedicated. Can we run variant compatibility and give a POC pricing sketch?

nina: Good callout. Two paths: rebased artifact (single model.tar) or adapter side-load. Rebased is simplest for us. For side-load we need adapter format + tokenizer + base_model_id. Do we know which they plan to deliver?

ryan: They said "rebased weights" in the email, but also mentioned a plugin for retrieval. I'll confirm artifact bundle.

claire: From product side: If rebased, run our variant-compat-scan (tokenizer check, rmsnorm signature, layer name patterns). If any mismatch we produce a remediation report. For retriever plugin, we treat as a separate sidecar service — needs network egress rules and a short security review.

samir: Perf/cost note: M7B quantized to int8 typically runs ~0.4x cost of our 13B baseline. For a POC at 100 qps sustained with 512-token responses, estimate hosted delta is modest, but sustained >1k qps pushes toward Dedicated. Quick rough: 100 qps * 512 tokens * 60 min ~3.07M tokens/hr. With batching/prefix cache you get ~1.8x efficiency. I'll follow up with numbers.

elena: Security: vendor questionnaire flagged two blockers: artifact provenance and retrieval plugin network access. For rebased weights, we need a signed manifest and proof of training data provenance (they can provide a statement). For retriever: must list endpoints, auth, and data retention. If plugin will query customer endpoints with secrets, we need an NDA + SOC discussion.

ryan: Action: I'll ask for artifact bundle + retriever README + signed manifest. Timeline target: deliver artifacts by Tue COB to get scan results by Thu. Is that realistic?

claire: Yes if artifacts arrive Tue morning. Our scan queue turnaround is ~48 hours on POC priority. If we see tokenizer mismatch we'll request tokenizer.json.

nina: Small note: Mistral forks sometimes use RMSNorm variations that break our loader. If RMSNorm mismatch we can auto-patch in many cases but it adds ~1 day. Call out to the customer.

deploy-bot: checklist: upload -> variant-compat-scan -> quant-sim -> privacy-review -> infra-provision. Status: awaiting artifact upload.

ryan: For pricing sketch: customer asked for a ballpark for 2-week POC with ~200k total queries. Suggest we quote hosted with a soft cap and an optional Dedicated trial credit. Any objections?

samir: No objections. Suggest we present two options: Hosted PAYG estimate + Dedicated 2-week reserved estimate (include infra credit). Include note that on-prem adds ~2w onboarding and infra validation.

elena: Also include a short security checklist in the quote: allowed artifact types, retention period (30 days by default for POC), and required attestations. That helps unblock their security team quickly.

claire: I'll prep a short onboarding checklist snippet they can follow. Paste below for us to sanity-check: 

```
required_artifacts: model.tar (rebased weights)
metadata.json: { base_model: "mistral-7b", tokenizer: "tokenizer.json", rmsnorm_version: "v2" }
retriever: retriever_readme.md + endpoint_list + auth_spec
license_and_manifest: signed_manifest.pdf
```

ryan: Perfect. I'll request everything and copy the customer-facing checklist + timeline (scan by Thu if Tue delivery).

nina: One more ops detail: if they require KV cache warmstart (they mentioned session continuity), we need to confirm whether they will provide warmstart checkpoints or if we should synthesize prefixes. Warmstart ingestion triggers privacy and retention flow.

elena: Yep—call that out. If they provide checkpoints, encryption + KMS keys required and storage exception must be signed by legal.

ryan: OK. I'll send the ask now and cc legal. Thanks team :rocket:

[thread end]
